# Open Phu Quoc

> Open Phu Quoc is an independent public information portal for residents and visitors to Phu Quoc, Viet Nam. The site provides practical island information in Vietnamese. Information changes with conditions and should be checked at the time of travel.

Canonical website: https://cms.openphuquoc.com/
Primary language: Vietnamese (vi-VN)
Coverage: Phu Quoc, Viet Nam

## Public sections
- [Today on the island](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/): Weather summaries, travel status and things to do today.
- [Weather](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/weather/): Detailed forecast and marine conditions, with observation and update times where available.
- [Airport](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/airport/): Phu Quoc flight information.
- [Transport](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/transit/): Ferry, high-speed passenger boats and island transport.
- [Go - where to go now](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/go/): Practical trip-planning guidance.
- [Near Me](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/nearme/): Useful places and essential services.
- [Destination guide](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/guide/knowledge.html): Published editorial destination articles.
- [Island stories](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/stories/): Published local stories.

## Discovery
- [Complete public XML sitemap](https://cms.openphuquoc.com/sitemap.xml)

## Important context
- The website is an information resource, not an official government or maritime authority.
- Weather, sea conditions, flights, ferry schedules and availability can change. Check update times and operators before departure.
- Only published public pages belong to this index. CMS administration, personal feedback and internal analytics are private.
- No unverified language-specific URLs should be inferred: translations will be listed only after they are published.
